verified_facts: title plan must be viewed with register
title plans are based on OS mapping
adjoining plans may use different OS mapping versions
large rural plans may be 1:5000 or 1:10000
undefined boundaries may be shown with pecked lines
HMLR does not routinely survey compatible deeds and OS detail
majority of registered titles use general boundaries
general boundary has no standard tolerance to legal boundary
title plan is not standalone legal-boundary proof
scale must not be converted into parcel-boundary precision
